name: quota-band
description: Account, quota, context and cache cards above the Claude Code prompt, with handoffs and a warning before a turn rewrites the prompt cache; quota and routing come from CLIProxyAPI with the quota-pilot plugin

handoffAt.title: Suggest a handoff at (% of context)
handoffAt.description: How full the context is, in percent, when the band suggests handing off to a new session that starts from a summary. 0 never suggests it; /handoff works either way.

confirmColdAbove.title: Ask before a cold turn above (tokens)
confirmColdAbove.description: Conversation size from which a message that would start a cold turn (the prompt cache expired, or the session moved to another account, provider or model) waits for you to confirm it, with what it costs. 0 never asks.

keepWarm.title: Keep the cache warm (times)
keepWarm.description: How many times the band refreshes the prompt cache while you are away, each shortly before it would expire, at about a tenth of the input price. 0 turns it off.
